title: Snapshots: saving and returning to a previous state

videos.script: A snapshot saves the state of a virtual machine, so you can come back to it later. It is the feature that makes a lab worth having. {{what}} Before an update, before a risky setting, before you try the thing the forum said to try: take a snapshot. If it goes wrong, one command and the machine is as it was, down to the files that were open. {{before}} There are two things to understand about it. What coming back does to the machine's clock. And how the snapshot is stored, because that decides what deleting one does. {{understand}} And one thing to never forget. A snapshot lives on the same disk as the machine. It protects you from your own mistakes, not from losing the disk. It is not a backup. {{backup}}
